    Create a function that returns True if the last character

    '''

candidates.question: How is a character considered "closely associated with a word"?
candidates.answer: Precisely: the last "word" (the substring after the final space, per split(' ')) must have length exactly 1 and be alphabetic -- if the last space-separated token has more than one character, the last character is NOT standalone and the function returns False.
